description: Effect roots (Svelte's $effect.root, M6 overlays: bits-ui's SharedState behind its body scroll lock, and its keyboard tracking): a root created while the app initialises, its $effect run after the mount and re-run when the value it reads changes (its cleanup first); destroying the root runs its effects' cleanups, then its function's; a root created by a handler; the value changing after a root is destroyed
